title: ork projects set: change a project's optional registry fields

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S136 (2026-10-27): ork projects has only list, add and rm, so the optional registry fields (push, ui_doc, worktree_pattern, branch_pattern, check command, budgets) can only be changed by editing the registry file by hand. The owner decided for S136 to edit the file for now. Add `ork projects set NAME --field VALUE` (daemon RPC, CLI, validation of each field, doctor message, docs/state.md and docs/design.md), and a TUI path later if wanted. Check slicer does not already provide the capability.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Interview the owner at preflight: which fields, the flag syntax, and whether it refuses while the project has unfinished runs.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/cli ./internal/daemon ./internal/registry; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
